fee_basis.fba_storage: monthly_storage_fees[YYYY-MM] = FBAStorageFee posted the following month, allocated to the month stored; daily fba_storage_posted keeps the cash-day amount
fee_basis.ordered_fees: ordered_referral_fees / ordered_fba_fulfillment_fees / ordered_other_fees = the same ItemFeeList fees booked on the order's purchase day (order id -> day from the All Orders report; unmapped orders stay on the posted day)

pending.note: ordered_*_pending = expected referral / FBA fee of order lines (last PENDING_FEE_DAYS) whose units Amazon has not posted fees for yet, priced with the SKU's own posted fee per unit and referral rate (fallback: account averages); replaced by the real fee as Amazon posts it

fee_basis.refund_fee_adjustments: fees Amazon returns on refunds, on the refund's posted day

markets.basis: daily[day].markets[CC] = the same-named fields of that marketplace only: All Orders report rows by sales-channel (Non-Amazon / MCF rows and rows without one -> default), Finances events by MarketplaceName (missing -> default); same day rules and signs as the row, so per day the sum over markets of each split field equals the row's field

not_split.adjustments: AdjustmentEvent / SAFE-T / removal revenue carry no MarketplaceName
not_split.net_sales: derived - per market it is gross_sales + refunds + promotions + shipping_credits + giftwrap_credits of the bucket
not_split.ordered_fba_fulfillment_fees_pending: expected fees priced with account-level SKU rates, not per market
not_split.ordered_referral_fees_pending: expected fees priced with account-level SKU rates, not per market
not_split.other_fees: also receives postage AdjustmentEvents without MarketplaceName (the ShipmentEvent part is split as ordered_other_fees)

sales_basis.ordered: ordered_* = All Orders report by purchase date (Seller Central / Sellerboard basis), Amazon.com channel, cancelled excluded
sales_basis.posted: gross_sales / fees / refunds = Finances API by posted (ship) date

warnings: unmapped service fee type (kept in service_fees): DealParticipationFee
unmapped service fee type (kept in service_fees): DealPerformanceFee
